# CASToolClusterPckg

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of CASToolClusterPckg is to serve state stream reach cluster assignments and figures.  

## Installation

You can install the development version of CASToolClusterPckg from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("laura-naslund/CASToolClusterPckg")
```

## Example

This is an example of how to retrieve the cluster assignments data and the cluster assignments figure.

```{r example}
library(CASToolClusterPckg)

## Retrieve cluster data frame
de_clust_2 <- retrieve_clust_data("Delaware", 2)
head(de_clust_2)

## Retrieve cluster figure
de_clust_2_fig <- retrieve_clust_fig("Delaware", 2)
magick::image_read(de_clust_2_fig)
```
